item.text: {"search_note":"I found no strong evidence of Tshisekedi using a dedicated crisis hotline, military deconfliction mechanism, or similarly explicit accidental-war prevention protocol in 2024. I also found no strong evidence of reckless crisis rhetoric from him in the sources searched. The best-supported pattern is channel-preserving and peace-oriented public messaging, but with fragile implementation and recurring breakdowns in the eastern Congo process.","evidence":[{"title":"Crise sécuritaire dans l’Est de la Rdc : Les Présidents Félix Tshisekedi et Salva Kiir appellent au respect des accords de paix","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-03-25","url":"https://presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/crise_securitaire_dans_lest_de_la_rdc_les_presidents_felix_tshisekedi_et_salva_kiir_appellent_au_respect_des_accords_de_paix","summary":"After meeting South Sudan’s president in Kinshasa, Tshisekedi publicly called for an urgent relaunch of the Nairobi and Luanda peace processes and said he would spare no effort to restore peace, security, and stability in eastern Congo and the region.
